# Generated output, do not edit here

This repository holds the automatically generated preview of the
lab website. It is overwritten in full on every rebuild, so
nothing in it can be edited meaningfully.

The website's source is
[predcommlab/labpage](https://github.com/predcommlab/labpage);
all editing happens there (see its MAINTENANCE.md). The rendered
preview is served at
<https://predcommlab.github.io/labpage-preview/>.
